export.heading: Export
export.description: Save AI providers and app settings to a file — to move to another machine or as a backup.
export.hintEncrypted: API keys are encrypted with a password. You will need the same password on import.
export.hintPlain: Provider API keys are saved in plain text. For local copies only.
export.hintNothingToEncrypt: Nothing to encrypt — the selected providers have no API keys.

import.heading: Import
import.description: Upload a previously exported file. Matching is determined by the provider id.

toast.notAnExportFile: This does not look like an HSE Studio export file
toast.encryptedFileHint: The file is encrypted — enter the password to import
